The vertical axis represents revenue in millions of USD, ranging from 0 to 1600 million, while the horizontal axis denotes the quarters within the specified timeframe. This chart displays seven distinct revenue categories, each represented by a different color from a pastel palette. The categories are Foreign Aid, Gas Exports, Hydrocarbons, Investments, Licensing, Taxation, and Trade. The stacked areas indicate the cumulative revenue contribution of each category over time. In the first quarter of 2022, Hydrocarbons (depicted in orange) start at approximately 515 million USD, showing a steady dominance throughout the period, peaking at around 535 million USD in the third quarter of 2023. Foreign Aid (shown in teal) begins at roughly 150 million USD, gradually rising to around 205 million USD by the fourth quarter of 2023. Trade (in light pink) starts at about 80 million USD, maintaining a relatively stable range between 80 and 100 million USD across the quarters. Taxation (in light blue) begins around 230 million USD and increases steadily, reaching approximately 285 million USD by the fourth quarter of 2023. Investments (in light purple) start at 65 million USD and exhibit a gradual upward trend, peaking at 85 million USD in the third quarter of 2023. Licensing (in light green) has the smallest contribution, starting at 45 million USD and remaining fairly consistent around 50 to 65 million USD throughout the period. Gas Exports (in yellow) begin at 140 million USD and show a slight increase, reaching up to 185 million USD by the third quarter of 2023 before slightly declining. The overall cumulative revenue starts at about 1225 million USD in 2022-Q1 and rises to approximately 1540 million USD by 2023-Q4, visually demonstrating the combined contributions of these revenue streams over time. The chart effectively highlights the relative significance and trends of each revenue category in Yemen's economy during this period.

I made three fixes in chart.py and re-ran it; output.png is regenerated.

1. **Wrong value:** LNG Exports (Balhaf) in 2023-Q4 was 135 and is now 100. Gas Exports for that quarter is now 165, matching table.csv. Aggregating the figure's traces by category reproduces every column of the table exactly (the check printed True).
2. **Title:** it now reads "Yemen Quarterly Revenue Streams (2022-2023)", matching summary.txt. I confirmed this from `fig.layout.title.text`.
3. **Legend:** I removed the `showlegend=False` line. `fig.layout.showlegend` is now None, the default, so the legend shows. The render shows the "Revenue Category" legend with all seven categories, to the right of the plot and not covering any data.

Nothing else in the chart was changed.
